items.content: Asian stocks looked set to rise after a rebound in chip shares fueled a Wall Street rally, reviving confidence in the artificial intelligence trade. The yen held onto its gains amid a report Japanese officials intervened to support the currency.

items.title: Yen Surges After Japan Intervened in Market Again Ahead of BOJ
items.content: The yen soared by the most in more than two years against the dollar after authorities stepped in once again to try and prop up the nation’s sagging currency ahead of the Bank of Japan’s policy decision.
items.contentSnippet: The yen soared by the most in more than two years against the dollar after authorities stepped in once again to try and prop up the nation’s sagging currency ahead of the Bank of Japan’s policy decision.
items.creator: John Cheng, Mia Glass and Carter Johnson

summaries.zh: 日元大幅飙升，创两年多来最大单日涨幅。在日本央行即将公布利率决议前，日本当局再次入市干预，以支撑持续贬值的日元。干预措施推动日元对美元汇率强劲上扬。
summaries.en: The yen surged against the dollar, recording its biggest single-day gain in more than two years. The sharp rally followed another round of intervention by Japanese authorities, who stepped in to support the weakening currency. The action occurred just ahead of the Bank of Japan's scheduled policy decision.

items.title: Weak Yen Offers Toyota an Earnings Respite From Tariffs, War
items.content: The yen’s slide to a 40-year low may be causing headaches for Japanese policymakers, but exporters such as Toyota Motor Corp. are set to reap an earnings boon, offering a much-needed respite from US tariffs, surging oil prices and strained supply chains.
items.contentSnippet: The yen’s slide to a 40-year low may be causing headaches for Japanese policymakers, but exporters such as Toyota Motor Corp. are set to reap an earnings boon, offering a much-needed respite from US tariffs, surging oil prices and strained supply chains.
items.creator: Nicholas Takahashi

summaries.zh: 日元跌至四十年低点，虽令日本决策层困扰，却为丰田等出口企业带来盈利提振。这一汇率优势为丰田缓解了美国关税、油价飙升及供应链紧张等多重压力。
summaries.en: The yen's depreciation to a 40-year low is boosting earnings for exporters like Toyota, providing a buffer against challenges including U.S. tariffs, rising oil prices, and supply chain disruptions. While the weak currency poses concerns for Japanese policymakers, it enhances Toyota's profits from overseas sales, offering a financial respite amid global trade tensions and economic pressures.

items.title: Strategy Shores Up Liquidity as Faithful Wait on Rebound
items.content: After roiling crypto markets with a sweeping overhaul of the financing model underpinning Strategy Inc.’s Bitcoin buying blueprint, Michael Saylor has investors wondering what’s next while reporting another multibillion loss tied to the declining value of the cryptocurrency accumulator’s holdings.
items.contentSnippet: After roiling crypto markets with a sweeping overhaul of the financing model underpinning Strategy Inc.’s Bitcoin buying blueprint, Michael Saylor has investors wondering what’s next while reporting another multibillion loss tied to the declining value of the cryptocurrency accumulator’s holdings.

summaries.zh: Strategy公司对支撑其比特币购买计划的融资模式进行重大调整，引发加密市场震荡。创始人Michael Saylor在公布因持仓贬值再度录得数十亿美元亏损的同时，着手加强流动性管理。尽管持有资产缩水，忠实投资者仍在等待市场反弹。
summaries.en: Strategy Inc. overhauled its Bitcoin financing model, unsettling crypto markets. CEO Michael Saylor now faces investor questions about future moves as the company reports another multibillion-dollar loss from the declining value of its cryptocurrency holdings. While shoring up liquidity, Strategy remains reliant on a Bitcoin rebound that its faithful shareholders are waiting for.

items.title: Swarthmore Loses AAA Rating From S&P Over Debtload
items.content: Swarthmore College, an elite liberal arts school in Pennsylvania, lost its AAA grade from S&P Global Ratings after running up its debts to finance renovations to dormitories, classrooms and other projects across its campus. Bloomberg's Amanda Albright reports on "Bloomberg Real Yield." (Source: Bloomberg)
